LightningComponentBundle.description: Display, search, and sort records for any object in your LWR site, with selection, inline editing, and actions.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object
property.description: The object whose records this component lists.

property.name: listView
property.label: List View
property.description: Supplies the columns, filter, and sort order. Choose an object first.

property.name: pageSize
property.label: Number of Records to Display
property.description: Records shown per page, from 1 to 2000.

property.name: showListViewPicker
property.label: Show List View Picker
property.description: Lets a visitor switch list views. The choice lasts for their visit and doesn't change this property.

property.name: showStatus
property.label: Show Status
property.description: The item count and sort field shown under the title.

property.name: disableUserLinks
property.label: Disable User Links
property.description: Shows user fields such as Owner as plain text instead of linking to their profile page. Use this when visitors can't see user profiles.

property.name: showDiagnostics
property.label: Show Diagnostics
property.description: Troubleshooting only. Displays the component's live data state below the table. Leave off for site visitors.
